title: Hug excess is window-bounded with quadratic tower arches
statement: At the representative reduced base (ln n' = 17.0826), the Birkhoff excess e(L) = sum_{k<L} F({k alpha}) - L C_* of the exact hug/IET orbit satisfies e(L) in (-0.28, 4.97] for every 1 <= L < 301994, and the DK price is never tight: |e|/(2 s(L)) <= 0.476 overall and <= 0.355 on [50508, 301994). Mechanism: along the level-9 tower L = m * 1054 the excess follows a quadratic arch (peak 2.99 at m = 12, closing to -0.04 at m = 24, roughly q_10/q_9), the classical phase-affine sawtooth picture; higher towers are flat (50508-tower <= 0.33). Conjectured consequence: per-tower arches bound e by O(max_j a_{j+1}) rather than Theta(s), i.e. the DK constant 2 s(L) is generically loose by a factor of order s / max a.
mathematical_domain: Juggler cycle finance / discrepancy of irrational rotations
tested_range: single-pass float census of all 301993 lengths at the fixed base; max |e| = 4.97 at L = 238541 (s = 17); running max saturates (1.87 at 1054, 4.72 at 24727, 4.97 at 301993); towers at 1054 and 50508 traced; fixed-base excesses match the 19 per-row DK-branch excesses to 6e-4
notes: Three structural laws FAILED on the same census and are recorded as negative knowledge: alternating digit sum (Pearson r = 0.21), additive digit law (least-squares r^2 = -0.39), endpoint coboundary e(L) = g(u_L) (max bin range 4.63 vs global range 5.25 - no collapse). The excess is a phase-history functional. No bound beyond the window is claimed, the certified envelope currency stays 2 s(L), and no new kills follow (the uniform window margin is already 5.48). The period-bound reading — that O(max_j a_{j+1}) pulls n*(478245) below the certified floor — is REFUTED (juggler_walk_arch_kills_blocker); the height statement itself is not refuted. Not a halt theorem.
